title: BIRT Reporting (GSoC 2013) and the birtreports add-on
description: The 2013 BIRT Reporting project in the Student Hall of Fame, and the life of the birtreports add-on in zap-extensions until its removal in 2021.

chapters.title: 2013: the first commit
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists BIRT Reporting (Rauf Butt) as a 2013 Summer GSoC project. The OWASP wiki idea page describes"a reporting module that will be integrated with the existing ZAP implementation"using BIRT. A zap-extensions commit dated 2013-10-09 is titled"BIRT Reporting with XML data source and Scripting - GSoC 2013 by Rauf Butt". On 2013-10-14"Added birtreports jars to top level lib directory"is dated.

chapters.title: 2014 to 2019: maintenance and relocation
chapters.text: A commit dated 2014-05-08 is titled"Removed "birtreports" runtime dependencies from main "lib" directory."Later commits include"birtreports: update ZAP logo"(2018-06-11) and"birtreports: stop using BrowserLauncher (#1685)"(2018-06-26)."birtreports: relocate to its own project"is dated 2019-04-03.

chapters.title: 2020 to 2021: merged extensions, then removed
chapters.text: "birtreports: merge extensions"is dated 2020-03-05. On 2021-03-09 a commit titled"Report Generation - first version"adds the reports add-on. On 2021-04-06"Remove superseded report add-ons"is dated; its message body reads"Remove `alertReport`, `birtreports`, `customreport`, and `exportreport`."There is no birtreports directory at the current head.
